validated_results.title: Syndecan-1-dependent suppression of PDK1/Akt/bad signaling by docosahexaenoic acid induces apoptosis in prostate cancer.
validated_results.reason: The study of DHA and syndecan-1/PDK1/Akt/Bad signaling was conducted exclusively in Pten knockout mice and human prostate cancer cell lines, providing no human incidence data.

validated_results.title: p27(Kip1) deficiency promotes prostate carcinogenesis but does not affect the efficacy of retinoids in suppressing the neoplastic process.
validated_results.reason: The 9-cis retinoic acid carcinogenesis experiments were performed only in p27(Kip1)-deficient mice, so there is no human exposure-outcome evidence.
